def execute_command(image) -> ImagePatch:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    man_patches = image_patch.find("man")
    shirt_patches = image_patch.find("shirt")
    
    if not man_patches or not shirt_patches:
        return image_patch
    
    man_centers = [(p.left + p.right) / 2 for p in man_patches]
    shirt_centers = [(p.left + p.right) / 2 for p in shirt_patches]
    
    closest_shirt_to_man = min(shirt_centers, key=lambda x: abs(x - man_centers[0]))
    shirt_index = shirt_centers.index(closest_shirt_to_man)
    
    shirt_patch = shirt_patches[shirt_index]
    
    return shirt_patch if shirt_patch.verify_property("shirt", "white") else image_patch

def answer_query(image):
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    clothing_patches = image_patch.find("black clothing")
    umbrella_patches = image_patch.find("umbrella")
    
    # If no black clothing or umbrella is found, return "No"
    if not clothing_patches or not umbrella_patches:
        return "No"

    # Sort the clothing patches by their distance to the umbrella patches
    clothing_patches.sort(key=lambda clothing: min(distance(clothing, umbrella) for umbrella in umbrella_patches))

    # Check if the nearest umbrella has black clothing under it
    nearest_umbrella = min(umbrella_patches, key=lambda umbrella: distance(clothing_patches[0], umbrella))
    return "Yes" if distance(clothing_patches[0], nearest_umbrella) < 0 else "No"
